denied.title: Access denied
denied.body: This account is signed in but is not a moderator or admin, so no moderation actions are available. Ask an admin to grant you the moderator role.

usage.title: Feature usage
usage.periodCaveat: Distinct users are exact within a period; a range spanning months may count a user active in two months twice (privacy-preserving monthly salt).

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Push send configuration: the global kill-switch, and each notification category's enable, local schedule hour, and foreground presentation (whether it is surfaced in-app while the app is open). Off is always the safe state — a disabled switch means no one is messaged. Categories appear here as the features that own them declare their notification type.
notifications.killSwitchDoc: Master switch. When off, no notification is sent for any category, whatever the per-category switches or users' preferences say.
notifications.overrideDoc: At least one of this category's switches has a stored value replacing its code default. Reset clears them all.
notifications.noCategories: No notification category is declared yet. One appears here as soon as a feature ships its notification type.

soundfonts.title: Sound fonts
soundfonts.intro: Manage the instrument SoundFont catalog. Adding a font uploads its .sf2 and records the catalog row together.
soundfonts.label: Label
soundfonts.priceNoSampleHint: This font has no sample yet: once it costs points, the app locks it and greys its play control until you generate one.

licenseDesc.cc0: CC0 1.0 — Public domain: no attribution required, free to reuse for any purpose.
licenseDesc.ccby: CC BY — Free to use, including commercially, as long as the author is credited.
licenseDesc.ccbysa: CC BY-SA — Attribution required, and derivatives must keep the same licence (ShareAlike).
licenseDesc.mit: MIT — Free to reuse and modify, commercially included, provided the licence notice travels with the file.

soundfonts.generateSampleHint: Render the short preview clip users hear when auditioning this font in the app.
soundfonts.previewRequired: Generate a preview sample before accepting this font.
soundfonts.familyMismatch: This file doesn’t match the declared family “{family}” — it holds no presets for that family.
soundfonts.confirmRemove: Remove this SoundFont? Its catalog row and stored file are both deleted.
soundfonts.previewHint: Pick a catalog piece and listen to it played with this SoundFont before saving.
soundfonts.previewNoFont: The stored SoundFont could not be loaded for preview.
soundfonts.previewNoPiece: The chosen piece could not be loaded.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.intro: Turn features on or off and tune config values at runtime — no redeploy. The backend enforces every flag; this panel is the control surface. Every change is audited.
flags.sensitiveHint: Legal or infrastructure value — not casually editable.
flags.sensitiveConfirm: “{key}” is a sensitive legal/infra value. Apply this change?
flags.locked: You can’t change this key — it needs a platform admin.
flags.jsonUnparsed: Couldn’t parse the stored value — editing as raw text.
flags.scopeDanglingHint: This scope names no existing campaign, so the flag currently reaches staff only. Pick an open campaign or another scope.
flags.scopeNoCampaign: The selected beta scope names no existing campaign — fix the scope, then save again.
flags.scopeUnverifiable: The campaign directory can’t be reached, so the scope couldn’t be checked. Nothing was saved — try again later.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Browse accounts with their roles, plan and betas. Open an account to see and manage everything about it — subscription, roles, audit history and sessions.

plans.revokeRowConfirm: Revoke this {source} row? Give a reason.
plans.revokeMembershipConfirm: Revoke the {campaign} membership? Give a reason.
plans.endDateHint: Leave empty for an open-ended grant — you must then tick the confirmation.
plans.confirmOpenEnded: I confirm an open-ended grant (no end date)
plans.closeEnrolmentConfirm: Close enrolment for {key}? No one else can join.
plans.closeCampaignConfirm: Close the {key} campaign? Its members lose the beta and it leaves the flags selector. Closing is a PAUSE: memberships are kept, and reopening restores them.
plans.mintedHint: Copy or download them now: they cannot be retrieved again.
plans.reopenCampaignConfirm: Reopen “{key}”? {n} membership(s) will be reactivated — individually revoked members stay out. Enrolment remains closed.
plans.reopenEnrolmentConfirm: Reopen enrolment for “{key}”? Its codes become redeemable again.
plans.closeTrialEnrolmentConfirm: Close enrolment for the {key} trial? No one else can join, but the trials ALREADY granted run to their own end date — closing does not take them back. To withdraw a granted premium, revoke the account's entitlement.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.intro: Run beta campaigns and premium trials, mint access codes and export their members. Music admins only; every change is audited.

takedowns.title: Private-score takedown
takedowns.intro: Find a reported private score and remove it. Removal is irreversible and audited.
takedowns.criterionRequired: Enter an owner id or a title fragment.
takedowns.confirmBody: This permanently deletes the score and its file. The owner loses it. An audit record is kept.
